Advance analytic PNR and device Philox clicks against AVX2 Frugal

Add analytic photon-subtraction polynomial trajectories and 16M new PNR records. Both selected K3 full-TV nominal joint-99% upper bounds are below one percent; preserve the pure squeezed parity boundary failure.

Move click RNG to CUDA Philox and repair Frugal Windows AVX2 summation ABI with an identical-body inline patch. Record all 86 timing panels, including small-system Frugal advantages and 2.052431 seconds per 4096 large four-branch samples without equal-quality claims.

Validation: 2630 independent checks; 861 tests run, 832 passed, zero failures/errors; ten new public API tests. All initial failed source versions and raw results retained.
